31242.a:
```
Firmware (BIOS/UEFI, POST)
   v
Bootloader (GRUB2 / systemd-boot)
   v
Kernel + initramfs (driver, root FS topish)
   v
switch_root -> /sbin/init (systemd, PID 1)
   v
default.target (multi-user / graphical)
   v
servislar, getty/sshd -> login
```
Tahlil: `systemd-analyze`, `systemd-analyze blame`, `journalctl -b`.

31243.a:
| | BIOS + MBR | UEFI + GPT |
|---|---|---|
| Boot kodi | MBR 446 bayt (stage1) | ESP'dagi `.efi` fayl |
| Disk limit | 2 TiB | ~9.4 ZB |
| Partition | 4 primary | 128 default |
| Secure Boot | yo'q | bor |
| Zaxira jadval | yo'q | GPT backup header |

Tekshirish: `[ -d /sys/firmware/efi ] && echo UEFI`. ESP odatda `/boot/efi`.

31244.a:
- `/etc/default/grub` — asosiy sozlama (`GRUB_TIMEOUT`, `GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX`, `GRUB_DEFAULT`).
- `/etc/grub.d/` — generator skriptlar.
- `/boot/grub/grub.cfg` (Debian) yoki `/boot/grub2/grub.cfg` — **generatsiya qilinadi**.

```sh
update-grub                                 # Debian/Ubuntu
grub2-mkconfig -o /boot/grub2/grub.cfg      # RHEL
grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="..."     # RHEL usuli
```

31245.a:
Kernel root FS'ni o'qish uchun driver kerak, driver esa root FS'da — tovuq-tuxum. **initramfs** shu muammoni hal qiladi:
- storage modullari, `lvm`, `mdadm`, `cryptsetup` (LUKS parol so'rash), udev.
- root topiladi, mount, `switch_root`.

```sh
update-initramfs -u        # Debian
dracut -f                  # RHEL
lsinitrd / lsinitramfs     # ichini ko'rish
```
**Gotcha:** root'ni LVM/yangi controller'ga ko'chirib, initramfs'ni yangilamaslik — `dracut emergency shell`, root topilmadi.

31246.a:
```sh
cat /proc/cmdline
# BOOT_IMAGE=/vmlinuz-6.8 root=UUID=... ro quiet splash
```
Foydali:
- `root=UUID=...`, `ro`/`rw`
- `systemd.unit=rescue.target` / `emergency.target`
- `init=/bin/bash` — systemd'siz, favqulodda
- `console=ttyS0,115200` — cloud serial console
- `systemd.unified_cgroup_hierarchy=1` — cgroup v2
- `mitigations=off` — xavfli, faqat benchmark

Bir martalik: GRUB menyuda `e` bosib tahrirlash. Doimiy: `GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX`.

31247.a:
| Runlevel | Ma'nosi | systemd target |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | o'chirish | `poweroff.target` |
| 1 (S) | single-user, rescue | `rescue.target` |
| 2 | multi-user, NFS'siz (Debian'da = 3) | `multi-user.target` |
| 3 | multi-user + network, text | `multi-user.target` |
| 4 | foydalanilmaydi | `multi-user.target` |
| 5 | grafik | `graphical.target` |
| 6 | reboot | `reboot.target` |

```sh
runlevel        # oldingi va joriy
who -r
```

31248.a:
**SysV:** `/etc/inittab` default runlevel; `/etc/rcN.d/S##name` (start), `K##name` (kill) — raqam tartibida, ketma-ket. Sekin, dependency qo'lda.

**systemd:** unit'lar (`.service`, `.socket`, `.mount`, `.target`), `Requires=/Wants=/After=` — graph, parallel start. Har servis o'z cgroup'ida — to'liq kill, resurs limit.

**Moslik:** `runlevel3.target` -> `multi-user.target` symlink; `telinit 3`, `init 6` hali ishlaydi.

```sh
ls -l /usr/lib/systemd/system/runlevel*.target
```

31249.a:
```sh
systemctl get-default                       # graphical.target
systemctl set-default multi-user.target     # serverga GUI kerak emas
systemctl isolate multi-user.target         # hozir o'tish (telinit 3)
systemctl list-units --type=target
systemctl list-dependencies multi-user.target
```
`set-default` — `/etc/systemd/system/default.target` symlink.

`isolate` faqat `AllowIsolate=yes` target'larda — boshqa servislarni to'xtatadi, SSH ustida ehtiyot bo'l.

31250.a:
- **rescue.target** (runlevel 1): `sysinit.target` bajariladi — barcha fstab FS mount, swap; network/servislar yo'q. Servis/config tuzatish uchun.
- **emergency.target**: faqat root (`ro`), fstab ishlanmagan. Buzilgan `fstab`, fsck muammosi uchun.

GRUB'da `e` -> `linux` qatoriga `systemd.unit=emergency.target`.
```sh
mount -o remount,rw /
vi /etc/fstab
systemctl daemon-reload; exit
```
RHEL'da root paroli bo'lmasa rescue kirmaydi — `rd.break` kerak.

31251.a:
```
GRUB menyu -> e -> linux qatori oxiriga: rd.break   (yoki init=/bin/bash)
Ctrl+X
```
```sh
mount -o remount,rw /sysroot
chroot /sysroot
passwd root                 # yoki vi /etc/fstab
touch /.autorelabel         # SELinux kontekst
exit; exit
```
**fstab tuzog'i:** muhim bo'lmagan disk uchun `nofail`, network FS uchun `_netdev` — yo'q bo'lsa boot emergency'da to'xtaydi.

**Cloud:** konsol yo'q bo'lsa — root diskni detach, yordamchi VM'ga attach, tuzatish, qaytarish.

**Security:** fizik/console kirish = root. GRUB parol, Secure Boot, LUKS — himoya.

31252.a:
**Ishonch zanjiri:**
```
UEFI db (Microsoft CA) -> shimx64.efi -> grubx64.efi -> vmlinuz -> kernel modullar
```
- **shim** — distro kalitini olib yuradi, MOK (`mokutil`) — user kalitlari.
- Imzosiz modul (NVIDIA, DKMS) — yuklanmaydi; MOK bilan imzolash kerak.
- Kernel **lockdown** rejimi — `/dev/mem`, imzosiz kexec bloklanadi.

Tekshirish: `mokutil --sb-state`.

Kengaytma: **measured boot** (TPM PCR) — LUKS kalitini TPM'ga bog'lash (`systemd-cryptenroll --tpm2`), remote attestation.

31253.a:
```sh
systemd-analyze                       # Startup finished in 3s (kernel) + 45s (userspace)
systemd-analyze blame | head
systemd-analyze critical-chain        # kritik yo'l
systemd-analyze plot > boot.svg
journalctl -b -p warning
```
**Tipik aybdorlar:**
- `systemd-networkd-wait-online` / `NetworkManager-wait-online` — interfeys kutadi.
- fstab'dagi yo'q disk — 90s `x-systemd.device-timeout`.
- cloud-init, DNS timeout.

`blame` uzun servis har doim ham aybdor emas — `critical-chain` kim kimni kutganini ko'rsatadi.

31254.a:
```ini
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```
```sh
systemctl enable nginx
# Created symlink /etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants/nginx.service -> ...
systemctl enable --now nginx   # enable + start
systemctl is-enabled nginx
```
- `enable` — boot'da ishga tushadi (hozir emas).
- `start` — hozir (boot'dan keyin qolmaydi).
- `mask` — `/dev/null` ga symlink, umuman ishga tushirib bo'lmaydi.

`After=` tartib, `Wants=/Requires=` — bog'liqlik; ular alohida tushunchalar.

31255.a:
**Strategiya:**
1. **Canary** — 1% node, metrikalar (boot muvaffaqiyati, latency, dmesg xatolar).
2. **Bir martalik boot:** `grub-reboot <yangi>` — muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa keyingi reboot eski kernel'ga (watchdog bilan).
3. **Rolling:** K8s'da `kubectl drain` + PDB, kured — avtomatik reboot koordinatori.
4. **Livepatch** — reboot'siz kritik CVE fix (vaqtinchalik, keyin baribir reboot).
5. **Kuzatuv:** serial console log, `kdump` crash dump.
6. **Immutable OS** — A/B partition, atomik rollback.

Principal savol: muvaffaqiyatsiz boot qanday aniqlanadi va kim rollback qiladi — inson emas, avtomatika.
